generationRules: Use only the observed order schema and relationship shape as a template.
Replace every source identifier, code, name, date and monetary value with synthetic values.
Keep operational status separate from approval status.
Include pending orders with approval and without approval, plus partially delivered, fully delivered and canceled scenarios.
Do not infer ERP absence from nfe:null or itens:[]; these values are retained as synthetic schema-compatible placeholders.
No correspondence table between source and synthetic records was created.
qualityNotes: This dataset is synthetic and must not be presented as an ERP extraction.
Original files were preserved outside data/ and are excluded by .gitignore.
